title: calamus ochrolepis
intro: Calamus ochrolepis, commonly known as yellow root or yellow flag, is a plant species native to North America, particularly in the eastern and central regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a popular remedy for digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Calamus ochrolepis include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and other volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal and aromatic qualities.
